sub_strands.name: Whole Numbers up to 10,000
performance_indicators: Read, write, and identify place value of digits in numbers up to 10,000.
Round off whole numbers to the nearest tens and hundreds.
Work out word problems involving addition and subtraction of numbers up to 10,000.

sub_strands.name: Fractions and Decimals
performance_indicators: Convert improper fractions to mixed numbers and vice versa using visual models.
Read and write decimals up to one decimal place using tenths fractions.

sub_strands.name: Time, Mass, and Volume
performance_indicators: Convert time units between hours, minutes, and seconds.
Solve practical problems involving mass additions in kilograms (kg) and grams (g).
Calculate volume of simple structural cubes and cuboids using unit cubes.

sub_strands.name: Angles and Algebraic Expressions
performance_indicators: Identify right angles, acute angles, and obtuse angles using clock hands or cardboard cutouts.
Simplify basic single-variable algebraic expressions involving addition and subtraction.

sub_strands.name: Oral Communication and Digital Narratives
performance_indicators: Listen attentively to informative texts and note key factual points precisely.
Use correct grammatical tenses to narrate events and express opinions clearly during group discussions.

sub_strands.name: Literacy, Vocabulary, and Media Texts
performance_indicators: Read informational and fictional texts fluently with accurate punctuation observance.
Deduce the meaning of unfamiliar vocabulary words using contextual sentence clues.
Analyze short media texts to identify main themes and character motivations.

sub_strands.name: Grammar and Composition
performance_indicators: Apply regular and irregular parts of speech correctly in structured writing prompts.
Compose multi-paragraph creative narratives using cohesive linking words and correct mechanics.

sub_strands.name: Mawasiliano ya Amali
performance_indicators: Kusikiliza kwa makini maelezo ya kiidara na kutoa muhtasari sahihi kwa maneno yajengayo.
Kutumia viambishi na ngeli za Kiswahili ipasavyo katika mazungumzo ya kila siku.

sub_strands.name: Ukusanyaji Taarifa na Fasihi
performance_indicators: Kusoma vitabu na vifungu vya habari kwa ufasaha, kasi inayofaa na kuzingatia viashiria vya vituo.
Kujibu maswali ya ufahamu ya moja kwa moja na yale yanayohitaji tahakiki na uamuzi.

sub_strands.name: Insha na Muundo wa Lugha
performance_indicators: Kuandika insha za wasifu na barua zisizo rasmi kwa kufuata miundo rasmi inayokubalika.
Kutumia alama za nukuu na mabano kwa usahihi katika sentensi na aya fupi.

sub_strands.name: Human Body and Special Plants
performance_indicators: Identify the external parts of the human digestive system and outline their primary roles.
Classify localized green and non-green plants based on visible structural properties.
Demonstrate safe practices when interacting with small animals within the school ecosystem.

sub_strands.name: States of Matter and Sound Energy
performance_indicators: Classify substances into solids, liquids, and gases using physical observation tests.
Demonstrate how sound travels through different materials via simple sensory experiments.

sub_strands.name: Effects of Forces and Basic Computing
performance_indicators: Demonstrate the effects of push and pull forces on the shape and movement of objects.
Identify core hardware and software components of a digital computing device.

sub_strands.name: Soil Conservation and Small Crops
performance_indicators: Demonstrate practical methods of recovering eroded soils using organic matter.
Establish and maintain container gardens for growing domestic vegetables and herbs.
Identify safe techniques for weeding and watering delicate young food crops.

sub_strands.name: Poultry and Small Livestock Maintenance
performance_indicators: Identify domestic poultry breeds and describe their basic water and feeding requirements.
Maintain clean environments for small farm animals to prevent pest outbreaks.

sub_strands.name: Nutrient Groups and Food Hygiene
performance_indicators: Classify common Kenyan foods according to their primary nutrient contributions.
Demonstrate sanitary kitchen habits, including clean container preservation and surface sorting.

sub_strands.name: Map Work and Physical Features
performance_indicators: Identify the eight compass directions and use them to locate key points on a county map.
Describe the formation and economic benefits of major landforms in their immediate county.
Analyze local weather instruments and plot variations using simple grid graphs.

sub_strands.name: Cultural Patterns and Historic Elements
performance_indicators: Outline language groups present in their home county and describe factors that unite them.
Identify and locate key historic monuments and cultural heritage sites within the county boundaries.

sub_strands.name: Economic Assets and Leadership Systems
performance_indicators: Identify core economic resources within the county and discuss environmental conservation methods.
Describe the structure and duties of the localized county government administration.

sub_strands.name: Graphic Media and 3D Construction
performance_indicators: Create patterns and simple layouts using stencils and cross-hatching pencil lines.
Model functional pots or vessels using clay coil and slab techniques.
Design basic decorative items using safe local fabrics and stitching skills.

sub_strands.name: Vocal Expression and Skits
performance_indicators: Sing programmatic topical melodies in tune, matching rhythmic beats accurately.
Perform scripted dramatic tableaus and short mimes conveying distinct civic values.

sub_strands.name: Athletics and Track Execution
performance_indicators: Demonstrate correct body posture during crouch starts and short sprints.
Execute safe jumping, landing, and dynamic balance adjustments during physical plays.

sub_strands.name: Biblical Guidance and Ethical Living
performance_indicators: Analyze biblical leadership qualities shown by historical figures like Samuel and Gideon.
Apply biblical teachings on self-control, respect, and hard work to daily home routines.
Locate books of the Old Testament using digital or physical bible indexes smoothly.

sub_strands.name: Surahs, Hadith, and Islamic Character
performance_indicators: Recite and internalize the foundational messages of Surah Al-Qari'ah and Surah At-Takathur.
Explain the conditions and spiritual importance of observing regular daily Salah.
Demonstrate kindness and helpful behaviors toward neighborhood elders as guided by the Hadith.

sub_strands.name: Value Solidification and Decision-Making
performance_indicators: Demonstrate proactive integrity and emotional awareness when handling peer pressures.
Apply constructive dispute resolution steps to maintain unity within the class layout.
Internalize moral and ethical values through systematic institutional peer reviews.
